# teco-ops main snapshot

Complete source snapshot for the SDAA custom-operator template. It contains the
native build, C++ correctness framework, SDPTI profiler, prototxt workloads, and
eight operator implementations. Read `README.md`, `doc/README_OP.md`,
`test/src/suite/executor.cpp`, and `test/src/device/sdaa/profiler.cpp` when
validating the test or scoring contract.
